requirement: Cryptographic entropy sampler ensuring complete isolation from mutable PRNG seeding (random.seed), enforcing SystemRandom CSPRNG usage, disallowing seed() injection methods, and enforcing valid population and PIN boundaries.
skeleton: IsolatedEntropySampler class with generate_pin, sample_population, and seed methods using secrets.SystemRandom.

rationale.teaches: An entropy sampler backed by secrets.SystemRandom that refuses seeding, requires at least 4 PIN digits, and validates sample size against the population.
rationale.why: SystemRandom and the global random module expose the same sample and randint API, so the difference is invisible to a shape test. The fixture seeds the global PRNG and checks the sampler's output is not reproducible.

candidates.why_wrong: The global random module backs the sampler, so a caller who seeds random reproduces every PIN.
The constructor seeds the global PRNG to 1337, so every process generates the same sequence.
seed is implemented and reseeds the global PRNG, so a caller can make the output deterministic.
A 1-digit PIN is accepted, so a PIN with ten possible values passes validation.
k larger than the population returns an empty list instead of raising, so a caller gets no sample and no error.
